Adds a feature to ...
Resolves ...

Closes #<issue-number>

### Pull-Request Checklist

- It is fine for some items to remain unchecked, provided they accurately reflect the current state.
- If an item is not applicable, replace its checkbox with `N/A`.

- [ ] Code is up-to-date with the `main` branch
- [ ] There are new or updated unit tests validating the change
- [ ] Docstring has been updated
- [ ] README.md has been updated
- [ ] Commit messages follow the [Conventional Commits specification](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/), for example, `fix(cli): fix a typo in the message`.

> - If linting fails, run `prek run -a` for more information.
> - If tests fail, run `uv run pytest` for more information.

### LLM use

- I used gpt-5.6-terra/opus-5.5/qwen3.7-plus **(replace with the appropriate model name)** with Claude Code/Codex/GitHub Copilot/Hermes/Pi/Cursor **(replace with the appropriate tool name)**.
- The code was entirely generated/partially generated/not generated **(select one)** by an LLM, and the user never read/took a glance at/fully read each line **(select one)** of the code.
